intents.title: Unified 4-Lens Overview with Compact Icon-Segmented Switcher
intents.statement: Integrate Radial, Constellation, Topology, and Blueprint into OverviewPage using a compact segmented switcher where inactive items collapse to clean icons and the active item displays its label, with zero star icons.

intents.statement: Decorate Topology edges with top cross-tier entrypoint symbols and display exact offending file and symbol paths on upward red violation curves.
